summary: Plan 06 P10 assigns reviewed decision records to shared package ownership and relocates their history from decisions/history to shared/decisions/history through a fail-closed expand/contract bridge.
rationale: Decision history is cross-stage governance authority, not a stage-local implementation. The migration first makes base-owned readers accept exactly one complete legacy or shared history, then performs exact per-file moves and updates living runtime references. Historical plan records continue to describe the paths that existed when those checkpoints ran; no permanent internal compatibility copy remains. This applies D7, D15 and D23 to the decisions mapping in Plan 06 section 13.
